# What is this mobile home park worth, and what is the next lot rent increase worth?

> Free mobile home park valuation calculator: type lots, occupancy, lot rent and expenses from a T-12 to see NOI, value at your cap rate, implied cap rate on the asking price, DSCR, and what a lot rent increase is worth after move-outs. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
